title: fix(cli): with no built Console, /_console/ answers 503 naming the remedy instead of a bare 404
body:
Fixes #22225
Clause-②: no

## What changes

When the Console package `os serve` resolves has no built `dist/`, the server printed the "Console dist not found" boot warning and mounted nothing at the HTTP surface. `GET /_console/` then answered the router's `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`, which looks exactly like a wrong URL (AGENTS.md, Route & surface ownership rule 3, "Absence must be loud").

On that same boot branch, `os serve` now also mounts `createConsoleNotBuiltPlugin(consolePath)` (`packages/cli/src/utils/console.ts`, internal, not on the `./console` subpath). It mounts the three routes the Console static plugin would mount:

| route | built Console (unchanged) | no built Console (new) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET /_console/*` | the SPA, from `dist/` | `503`, `text/plain`, `cache-control: no-store`: the Console is not built, then the remedy |
| `GET /_console` | `302` to `/_console/` | `302` to `/_console/` |
| `GET /` | `302` to `/_console/` | `302` to `/_console/` |

**One remedy picker.** `formatConsoleDistMissingWarning` now renders a private helper, `describeConsoleDistMissing(consolePath, hostPaths)`. That helper holds the one `findConsoleBuildRoot` decision and the one copy of the remedy prose. The boot warning calls it with `hostPaths: true`, and its bytes are unchanged (the existing `console-resolve.test.ts` pins pass as before). The HTTP answer calls it with `hostPaths: false`. There is no second picker and no copied sentence.

**`GET /`: redirect.** This is the card's design call. `/` redirects to `/_console/` whether or not the Console is built. Three reasons:

- The route keeps one owner and one answer: the Console's. The not-built plugin claims `/` on exactly the boots where the static plugin would have claimed it. It registers at the same point in `serve.ts`, so it shadows nothing the built case did not already shadow.
- Building the Console and restarting changes only what `/_console/*` returns.
- A browser following `/` lands on the not-built page.

**Status `503`, not `404`.** The address is right, and the server is missing a build artifact. The operator fixes that, not the caller. A caller that reads only the status code can still tell this apart from a wrong URL.

**Plain text, not a JSON envelope.** These routes are the Console's `static-asset` family in `console-route-ledger.ts`, not API surface. The `503` body is read by a browser or by `curl`, and a JSON envelope would put an API-shaped body on a route the ledger keeps static-asset only.

## What an anonymous caller is told (the card's H4)

Anyone who can reach the port can read the HTTP answer, with no credential. The terminal warning is read by the operator. So the HTTP form leaves out every absolute path on the host, and keeps the remedy:

- **Framework checkout:** `Console dist not found at packages/console/dist — ... Build it with pnpm objectui:build in the root of the ObjectStack checkout this server runs from (...)`. The terminal names the absolute root; the HTTP form names the repository-relative `packages/console/dist`, which is the repo's public layout.
- **Installed CLI:** `Console dist not found — the Console ships prebuilt in @objectstack/console, a dependency of @objectstack/cli; reinstall it at the same version as the CLI.` The terminal names the absolute `.../node_modules/.../dist` path, which can reveal the install layout and version. The HTTP form drops it.

## Help text

The `--ui` help text in `serve.ts`, the `packages/cli/README.md` row and the mount comment in `serve.ts` now name `@objectstack/console`, the package `resolveConsolePath` reads, instead of `@object-ui/console`.

## Measured on the real composition

Each boot ran `os serve` from source (`bin/run-dev.js` through tsx) on a bare `export default {};` config, with `OS_DATABASE_URL=:memory:`. The worktree's `packages/console` has no `dist/`, so it is the console package the CLI resolves. Responses were read with `curl -i`.

| boot | `GET /_console/` | `GET /` | `GET /_console` | boot output |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| before: this head with the two not-built mount lines in `serve.ts` ablated (BASE's composition; restore proven blob-equal to HEAD) | `404` `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` | `404` `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` | `404` `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` | warning printed once |
| after, no dist | `503`, the body below | `302` to `/_console/` | `302` to `/_console/` | warning printed once; `ConsoleNotBuilt` in the plugin list; no `Console:` banner row |
| after, `--no-ui` | `404` `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` | `404` `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` | n/a | no warning, nothing mounted |
| after, control: a fixture `@objectstack/console` with `dist/index.html` in the cwd | `200` `text/html`, the shell with the base tag injected | `302` to `/_console/` | `302` to `/_console/` | `ConsoleUI` loaded, `Console:` banner row |

`GET /api/v1/health` answered `200` on the no-dist boot. The not-built body, as served:

```text
The ObjectStack Console is not built, so this server has no Console to serve at /_console/.

Console dist not found at packages/console/dist — `pnpm build` does not produce it. Build it with `pnpm objectui:build` in the root of the ObjectStack checkout this server runs from (uses a ../objectui checkout if present, else clones objectui at the pinned commit — needs network).

Then restart the server. The API is served either way.
```

The card's measurement had `GET /` returning an empty `404` body. At BASE through this composition, it answered the same `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` JSON as `/_console/`. Either way it was indistinguishable from a wrong URL.

## Tests

`packages/cli/src/utils/console.not-built.test.ts` (unit tier) runs the real plugins on a real `HonoHttpServer`:

- **Framework tree:** `GET /_console/`, a client-side route and a hashed-asset path each answer `503`, `text/plain` and `no-store`. Each body's first line is the not-built headline, and each names `pnpm objectui:build`. The body is the boot warning's sentence with only the absolute build root replaced, and it does not contain that root.
- **Install tree:** the body is the warning's sentence with the dist path removed. It names `@objectstack/console`, not `pnpm objectui:build`, and contains no path of the project.
- **Redirects:** `/` and `/_console` redirect to `/_console/` in both trees.
- **Controls:** a built dist served by `createConsoleStaticPlugin` answers `200` with the shell and the same redirects. With no Console plugin mounted, `/` and `/_console/` are the bare `404`.

`test/published-subpath-console.pin.test.ts` lists the new export in `INTERNAL_SINCE_RETIREMENT`, so the partition of `utils/console.ts` still accounts for every export and the public face stays exactly three names.

Three ablations each made the test fail, as expected. Each was applied with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: anchor hit 1 to 0, blob changed, and restore proven blob-equal to HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty. The test imports `./console.js` relatively, so it reads `src/` and no `dist/` was involved.

| ablation | result |
| --- | --- |
| delete the `/_console/*` 503 mount | 5 failed / 4 passed |
| render the HTTP answer with `hostPaths: true` | 2 failed / 7 passed (both no-host-path assertions) |
| drop the `/` redirect | 2 failed / 7 passed (both redirect tests) |

## Verification (all at `813ff4827`, this PR's head)

- **Build.** The dependency closure was built with `pnpm turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/cli^...' --concurrency=2` (58/58 tasks), then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli build`. Lock verdict for both: `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- **Unit tests.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2`: `Test Files 272 passed (272)`, `Tests 4003 passed (4003)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. `vitest list --project unit` confirms that `console.not-built.test.ts`, `published-subpath-console.pin.test.ts`, `console-route-ledger.conformance.test.ts` and `console-resolve.test.ts` are in that run.
- **Typecheck.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`, then `check:test-typecheck` over `tsconfig.test.json`) exited 0. The test-layer debt held, with no new error.
- **Integration tests: left to CI.** This diff changes no integration-tier file, no `bin/` entry and no `test/helpers/serve-process.ts`. No queue-tier integration test boots `serve` with the Console enabled: `runServe` pins `OS_DISABLE_CONSOLE=1`, and a grep of the 98 integration files for serve/dev/start spawns that set neither `OS_DISABLE_CONSOLE` nor `--no-ui` turned up only flow-node `'start'` ids and a `dev` refusal pin.
- **Dispatch gates.** The gate lead's 66 lines, plus `pnpm check:cli-test-child-env` (added when the list was re-derived with no paths at this head), all exited 0. `dispatch-gates --ran` says: `67 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 67 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 67 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`.
- **Lint (`pnpm lint`), narrowed to the changed files.** `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 6 changed files: eslint's own config linted 4 (`serve.ts`, `console.ts` and the two tests) with 0 errors and 0 warnings. It ignored the 2 `.md` files ("File ignored because no matching configuration was supplied"). The narrowing loses nothing: `eslint.config.mjs` never enables type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, no typed rules), and the only files it reads at load are baselines this diff does not touch. So no untouched file's result can change. The full `pnpm lint` run is CI's.
- **Main has moved.** `origin/main` gained 4 commits since `b1f7a7a73`. None touches a file in this diff, and `git merge-tree` merges cleanly.

## Acceptance notes

- **`console-route-ledger.ts` notes, not amended here.** `GET /`, `GET /_console` and `GET /_console/*` are now mounted by two factories in `utils/console.ts`, on mutually exclusive boots. The ledger rows' route, `mountedIn` and `static-asset` disposition stay true, and the conformance census passes. But each row's `family` and note describe only `createConsoleStaticPlugin`. The file is outside this card's claimed file surface, so it is left for a follow-up. Suggested note addition per row: "Also mounted by `createConsoleNotBuiltPlugin` when the console package resolves without a `dist/`: the same redirect, or for `/_console/*` a `503` plain-text answer naming the build or reinstall remedy."
- **Same family, not fixed here: a drift-refused dev boot.** `os serve --dev` refuses to mount a Console whose `dist/.objectui-sha` differs from the repo pin. Measured on a fixture with pin `aaaa…` and stamp `bbbb…`: the terminal prints the refusal block, and `GET /_console/` and `GET /` answer `404` `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`. That is the same bare 404, with a different remedy (`formatConsoleShaDriftRefusal`, which names an absolute pin-file path). Reported to the dispatching seat.
- **Observations, not filed:** `GET /forms/:slug` (the public form short link) is mounted only with a built Console, so with no build it falls through to `404`. If the console package does not resolve at all (`consolePath` is `null` without `--no-console`), nothing is printed and nothing is mounted. That needs a broken install, and no public reach was measured.
